function mulberry32(a: number) {
  return function() {
    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }
}

function formatOutput(paragraphs: string[], wrapper: Wrapper): string {
  switch (wrapper) {
    case 'p': return paragraphs.map(p => `<p>${p}</p>`).join('\n');
    case 'h1': return paragraphs.map(p => `<h1>${p}</h1>`).join('\n');
    case 'ul': return `<ul>\n${paragraphs.flatMap(p => splitSentences(p)).map(s => `  <li>${s}</li>`).join('\n')}\n</ul>`;
    case 'markdown': return paragraphs.join('\n\n');
    default: return paragraphs.join('\n\n');
  }
}

ts
Copy

useEffect(() => {
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    const mod = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (!mod) return;
    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); regenerate(); }
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') {
      const sel = window.getSelection()?.toString();
      if (sel) return;
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      copyPlain();
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
}, [copyPlain, regenerate]);

const randInt = (rng, min, max) => Math.floor(rng() * (max - min + 1)) + min;

function pick(rng, bank) { return bank[Math.floor(rng() * bank.length)]; }

function makeSentence(rng, bank, minW = 7, maxW = 15) {
  const n = randInt(rng, minW, maxW);
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) parts.push(pick(rng, bank));
  if (n > 6 && rng() > 0.6) {
    const idx = randInt(rng, 2, n - 2);
    parts[idx] = parts[idx] + ',';
  }
  let s = parts.join(' ');
  s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) + '.';
  return s;
}

function generateByChars(rng, bank, target, measure) {
  const sents: string[] = [];
  let text = '';
  let guard = 0;
  while (measure(text) < target && guard++ < 500) {
    const s = makeSentence(rng, bank, 8, 18);
    sents.push(s);
    text = sents.join(' ');
  }
  // trim words
  let words = text.split(' ');
  while (words.length > 1 && measure(words.join(' ')) > target) words.pop();
  text = words.join(' ');
  if (!/[.!?]$/.test(text)) text += '.';
  // chunk into paragraphs
  const paras: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sents.length; i += 3) paras.push(sents.slice(i, i+3).join(' '));

function makeSentence(pool, minW=7, maxW=16){
  const n = minW + Math.floor(Math.random()*(maxW-minW+1));
  const words = [];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++) words.push(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
  // comma insertion
  if(n>10 && Math.random()<0.5){ words[Math.floor(n/2)] += ','; }
  if(n>13 && Math.random()<0.3){ words[Math.floor(n/3)] += ','; }
  words[0] = words[0][0].toUpperCase()+words[0].slice(1);
  let s = words.join(' ');
  s += (Math.random()<0.08?'?':'.');
  return s;
}

async function copyRich(html, text){
  try{
    const item = new ClipboardItem({
      'text/html': new Blob([html], {type:'text/html'}),
      'text/plain': new Blob([text], {type:'text/plain'})
    });
    await navigator.clipboard.write([item]);
  }catch(e){ await copyText(text); }
}

Ah â€” one more: input[type=range] needs background set with the gradient, and height:5px. The thumb needs margin-top offset if track height differs... With appearance:none on the input itself and thumb styled, the thumb centers automatically in Chrome when input height is small. Actually with -webkit-slider-thumb and input height 5px, the thumb is centered if we set margin-top: calc((5px - 18px)/2). When using appearance:none on the input element (not the track), Chrome centers the thumb over the input's content box. Hmm, safer: style ::-webkit-slider-runnable-track with height 5px and thumb with margin-top -6.5px.

  background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);font-size:13px;font-weight:550;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),opacity .22s}
.toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0);opacity:1}
.toast .tk{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(74,222,128,.95);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#062}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--track);border-radius:99px;border:3px solid transparent;background-clip:content-box}
::selection{background:rgba(125,211,252,.3)}
</style>

No manual find-and-replace.</p>

  <!-- ================= FAQ ================= -->
  <section class="blk" id="faq">
    <div class="sec-head">

      <h2>Questions, answered.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list" id="faqList">
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">What is a lorem ipsum generator?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>A lorem ipsum generator produces dummy placeholder text so designers and developers can fill layouts, wireframes, mockups and CMS templates before real copy exists. The classic Latin passage dates back to Cicero's <em>De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum</em> (45 BC) and has been the design industry's standard filler since the 1500s.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Can I generate an exact number of characters or bytes?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>Yes. Switch the <strong>Generate by</strong> control to <em>Characters</em> and the generator will produce text trimmed to the nearest word boundary under your limit â€” perfect for meta descriptions, tweet-length previews, or database column constraints. The live character counter in the output header updates as you drag the slider.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">What are the Startup SaaS and Tech Geek flavors?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>They are themed word banks that replace Latin with vocabulary real teams use. <strong>Startup SaaS</strong> generates terms like <code>north-star</code>, <code>runway</code> and <code>product-market</code>; <strong>Tech Geek</strong> uses <code>middleware</code>, <code>idempotent</code> and <code>race-condition</code>. They make landing-page demos and internal prototypes feel far more convincing than Latin.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Can I copy the text with HTML tags already applied?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>Absolutely. Choose a wrapper such as <code>&lt;p&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;</code> or Markdown, then hit <strong>Copy plain</strong> to get the raw markup. If you want formatted text for Figma, Notion or Google Docs, use <strong>Copy rich text</strong> â€” it places properly styled HTML on your clipboard via the async Clipboard API.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Is this tool free, and is my text stored anywhere?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>It is completely free with no account, no usage cap and no ads. All generation happens 100% client-side in your browser â€” nothing you type or generate is ever transmitted to a server, logged or stored.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ---------------- word banks ---------------- */
const FLAVORS = {
  latin: {
    label:"Latin",
    words:("lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipiscing elit sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua enim ad minim veniam quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi aliquip ex ea commodo consequat duis aute irure in reprehenderit voluptate velit esse cillum eu fugiat nulla pariatur excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident sunt culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum vestibulum curabitur pellentesque fermentum aliquam maecenas mauris nunc congue nisi viverra accumsan in nisl tincidunt eget nullam non nisi est sit amet facilisis magna etiam tempor orci eu lobortis elementum nibh tellus molestie").split(" ")
  },
  saas: {
    label:"Startup SaaS",
    words:("leverage synergy paradigm disrupt scalable growth north-star runway pivot iterate ship launch roadmap onboarding retention churn funnel conversion cohort metrics dashboard insights velocity bandwidth stakeholder alignment ecosystem flywheel moat playbook touchpoint delight friction seamless robust holistic granular actionable best-in-class mission-critical growth-hack product-market buy-in circle-back deep-dive double-click ideate operationalize synergize unlock empower streamline accelerate optimize monetize validate benchmark segment activate").split(" ")
  },
  tech: {
    label:"Tech Geek",
    words:("async middleware runtime regex docker kubernetes git rebase merge commit deploy pipeline endpoint payload cache latency thread mutex semaphore heap stack pointer null undefined closure promise callback hook reducer state props bundle transpile lint refactor monorepo microservice serverless container orchestration telemetry schema migration shard replica idempotent polymorphic recursive binary hex buffer socket daemon kernel shell sudo").split(" ")
  },
  cyber: {
    label:"Cyberpunk",
    words:("neon chrome rain sprawl consortium black-ice dermal grid arcology synth implant netrunner datajack corp zaibatsu hacker deck neural static hologram decay smog platinum circuit overclock glitch cyberware biotech firmware uplink downlink firewall encryption access-code night-city rain-slicked vapor haze chrome-plated augmented rogue singularity").split(" ")
  },
  food: {
    label:"Gourmet",
    words:("saffron truffle seared confit emulsion miso yuzu sourdough caramelized infused braised reduction gastrique umami artisan heirloom foraged fermented smoked charred drizzle zest blanched julienne bechamel roux sous-vide marbled tartare crudo consomme veloute beurre fondant ganache praline citrus herbaceous peppery silken").split(" ")
  }
};

const UNITS = [
  {id:"paragraphs", label:"Paragraphs", unit:"paragraphs", min:1, max:20, def:3},
  {id:"sentences",  label:"Sentences",  unit:"sentences",  min:1, max:60, def:5},
  {id:"words",      label:"Words",      unit:"words",      min:5, max:800, def:60},
  {id:"chars",      label:"Characters", unit:"characters", min:20, max:5000, def:400}
];

const WRAPS = [
  {id:"none", label:"Plain"},
  {id:"p",    label:"<p>",   mono:true},
  {id:"h1",   label:"<h1>",  mono:true},
  {id:"ul",   label:"<ul><li>", mono:true},
  {id:"md",   label:"Markdown"}
];

/* ---------------- state ---------------- */
const state = {
  flavor:"latin",
  unit:"paragraphs",
  amount:3,
  wrap:"none",
  classic:true,
  view:"code"
};

/* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
const rnd = n => Math.floor(Math.random()*n);
const pick = a => a[rnd(a.length)];
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

function makeSentence(pool, minW, maxW){
  minW = minW || 7; maxW = maxW || 16;
  const n = minW + rnd(maxW - minW + 1);
  const words = [];
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++) words.push(pick(pool));
  if (n > 10 && Math.random() < .55) words[Math.floor(n/2)] += ",";
  if (n > 13 && Math.random() < .3)  words[Math.floor(n/3)] += ",";
  let s = words.join(" ");
  s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  s = s.replace(/,$/, "");
  s += (Math.random() < .07 ? "?" : ".");
  return s;
}

function makeParagraph(pool){
  const n = 3 + rnd(4);
  const out = [];
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++) out.push(makeSentence(pool));
  return out.join(" ");
}

const CLASSIC = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.";

/* ---------------- generation ---------------- */
function generateParagraphs(){
  const pool = FLAVORS[state.flavor].words;
  let paras = [];

  if (state.unit === "paragraphs"){
    for (let i=0;i<state.amount;i++) paras.push(makeParagraph(pool));
  }
  else if (state.unit === "sentences"){
    const s = [];
    for (let i=0;i<state.amount;i++) s.push(makeSentence(pool));
    paras.push(s.join(" "));
  }
  else if (state.unit === "words"){
    let words = [];
    let guard = 0;
    while (words.length < state.amount && guard++ < 400){
      const s = makeSentence(pool, 6, 14).replace(/[.?!]$/,"");
      words = words.concat(s.split(" "));
    }
    words = words.slice(0, state.amount);
    let txt = words.join(" ").replace(/,$/,"");
    paras.push(txt + ".");
  }
  else { /* characters */
    let text = "";
    let guard = 0;
    while (text.length < state.amount && guard++ < 400){
      text += (text ? " " : "") + makeSentence(pool, 6, 14);
    }
    text = text.slice(0, state.amount);
    const lastSpace = text.lastIndexOf(" ");
    if (lastSpace > state.amount * 0.75) text = text.slice(0, lastSpace);
    paras.push(text.replace(/[,\s]+$/,""));
  }

  if (state.classic && state.flavor === "latin" && (state.unit === "paragraphs" || state.unit === "sentences")){
    paras[0] = CLASSIC + " " + paras[0];
  }
  return paras;
}

function applyWrap(paras){
  switch(state.wrap){
    case "p":  return paras.map(p => "<p>" + p + "</p>").join("\n");
    case "h1": return paras.map(p => "<h1>" + p + "</h1>").join("\n");
    case "ul": return "<ul>\n" + paras.map(p => "  <li>" + p + "</li>").join("\n") + "\n</ul>";
    case "md": return paras.map(p => "- " + p).join("\n");
    default:   return paras.join("\n\n");
  }
}

function plainFrom(paras){ return paras.join("\n\n"); }

/* ---------------- rendering ---------------- */
const outEl = $("out");

function render(){
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const paras = generateParagraphs();
  const wrapped = applyWrap(paras);
  const plain = plainFrom(paras);

  if (state.view === "rendered" && ["p","h1","ul"].indexOf(state.wrap) !== -1){
    outEl.classList.add("rendered");
    outEl.innerHTML = wrapped;
  } else {
    outEl.classList.remove("rendered");
    outEl.textContent = wrapped;
  }

  const words = plain.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const chars = plain.length;
  const secs = Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 200 * 60));
  $("statWords").textContent = words.toLocaleString();
  $("statChars").textContent = chars.toLocaleString();
  $("statRead").textContent = secs < 60 ? secs + "s" : Math.round(secs/60) + "m";

  const t1 = performance.now();
  return { plain, wrapped, ms: (t1 - t0).toFixed(2) };
}

/* ---------------- controls build ---------------- */
function buildChips(containerId, items, current, onPick, monoKey){
  const el = $(containerId);
  el.innerHTML = "";
  items.forEach(function(it){
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.className = "chip" + (it.mono ? " mono" : "");
    b.textContent = it.label;
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(it.id === current));
    b.dataset.id = it.id;
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){ onPick(it.id); });
    el.appendChild(b);
  });
}
function syncChips(containerId, id){
  Array.prototype.forEach.call($(containerId).children, function(b){
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.id === id));
  });
}

function currentUnit(){ return UNITS.filter(u => u.id === state.unit)[0]; }

function setAmount(v){
  const u = currentUnit();
  v = Math.max(u.min, Math.min(u.max, Math.round(v) || u.min));
  state.amount = v;
  $("amount").value = v;
  $("amountNum").value = v;
  const pct = ((v - u.min) / (u.max - u.min)) * 100;
  $("amount").style.setProperty("--pct", pct + "%");
  $("amtHint").textContent = v === 1 ? u.unit.replace(/s$/,"") : u.unit;
}

function setUnit(id){
  state.unit = id;
  syncChips("units", id);
  const u = currentUnit();
  $("amount").min = u.min;
  $("amount").max = u.max;
  $("amount").step = 1;
  let v = u.def;
  if (state.unit === "words") v = 60;
  if (state.unit === "chars") v = 400;
  if (state.unit === "sentences") v = 5;
  if (state.unit === "paragraphs") v = 3;
  setAmount(v);
  render();
}

/* ---------------- toast ---------------- */
let toastTimer;
function toast(msg){
  $("toastMsg").textContent = msg;
  const t = $("toast");
  t.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove("show"); }, 1900);
}

/* ---------------- clipboard ---------------- */
function legacyCopy(text){
  const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
  ta.value = text;
  ta.style.position = "fixed";
  ta.style.opacity = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.select();
  try { document.execCommand("copy"); } catch(e){}
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
}

async function copyPlain(){
  const r = render();
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text Â· " + r.plain.length.toLocaleString() + " chars");
  } catch(e){
    legacyCopy(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text");
  }
}

async function copyRich(){
  const r = render();
  const html = r.plain.split(/\n{2,}/).map(function(p){ return "<p>" + p + "</p>"; }).join("");
  try {
    if (window.ClipboardItem){
      const item = new ClipboardItem({
        "text/html": new Blob([html], {type:"text/html"}),
        "text/plain": new Blob([r.plain], {type:"text/plain"})
      });
      await navigator.clipboard.write([item]);
      toast("Copied as rich text Â· paste into Figma or Docs");
    } else {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(r.plain);
      toast("Copied as plain text");
    }
  } catch(e){
    legacyCopy(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text (rich copy unavailable)");
  }
}

/* ---------------- init ---------------- */
function init(){
  buildChips("flavors",
    Object.keys(FLAVORS).map(function(k){ return {id:k, label:FLAVORS[k].label}; }),
    state.flavor,
    function(id){
      state.flavor = id;
      syncChips("flavors", id);
      $("classicRow").style.display = (id === "latin") ? "flex" : "none";
      render();
    }
  );

  buildChips("units", UNITS, state.unit, setUnit);

  buildChips("wraps", WRAPS, state.wrap, function(id){
    state.wrap = id;
    syncChips("wraps", id);
    const canRender = ["p","h1","ul"].indexOf(id) !== -1;
    const rTab = document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="rendered"]');
    rTab.disabled = !canRender;
    if (!canRender && state.view === "rendered"){
      state.view = "code";
      document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="code"]').setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");
      rTab.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
    }
    render();
  });

  $("amount").addEventListener("input", function(e){ setAmount(+e.target.value); render(); });
  $("amountNum").addEventListener("input", function(e){ setAmount(+e.target.value); render(); });
  $("minus").addEventListener("click", function(){ setAmount(state.amount - 1); render(); });
  $("plus").addEventListener("click", function(){ setAmount(state.amount + 1); render(); });

  $("classicSwitch").addEventListener("click", function(){
    state.classic = !state.classic;
    this.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(state.classic));
    render();
  });

  $("regen").addEventListener("click", function(){
    const r = render();
    toast("Regenerated in " + r.ms + " ms");
  });

  $("copyPlain").addEventListener("click", copyPlain);
  $("copyRich").addEventListener("click", copyRich);

  $("dl").addEventListener("click", function(){
    const r = render();
    const blob = new Blob([r.wrapped], {type:"text/plain;charset=utf-8"});
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = "placeholder-" + state.flavor + "-" + Date.now() + ".txt";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1500);
    toast("Downloaded .txt");
  });

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button"), function(b){
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){
      if (b.disabled) return;
      state.view = b.dataset.view;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button"), function(x){
        x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x.dataset.view === state.view));
      });
      render();
    });
  });

  /* FAQ accordion */
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item"), function(item){
    const q = item.querySelector(".faq-q");
    const a = item.querySelector(".faq-a");
    q.addEventListener("click", function(){
      const isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item"), function(other){
        other.classList.remove("open");
        other.querySelector(".faq-a").style.maxHeight = "0px";
      });
      if (!isOpen){
        item.classList.add("open");
        a.style.maxHeight = a.scrollHeight + "px";
      }
    });
  });

  /* theme */
  $("themeBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const next = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    toast(next === "dark" ? "Dark mode" : "Light mode");
  });

  /* keyboard shortcuts */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    const mod = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (mod && e.key === "Enter"){
      e.preventDefault();
      const r = render();
      toast("Regenerated in " + r.ms + " ms");
      return;
    }
    if (mod && (e.key === "c" || e.key === "C")){
      const sel = window.getSelection();
      if (sel && sel.toString().length > 0) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      copyPlain();
    }
  });

  /* boot */
  $("classicRow").style.display = "flex";
  setUnit("paragraphs");
  render();
}

init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Generator & Page Highlights

Here's how the main pieces fit together.

  • Interactive generator panel â€“ On the left, you can pick from five text flavors (Latin, Startup SaaS, Tech Geek, Cyberpunk, Gourmet), switch the generation unit (paragraphs, sentences, words, or characters), and adjust the amount with a slider or stepper. Every change instantly updates the output.

  • Live preview & export â€“ The output card shows the generated text in code view or rendered HTML view when using <p>, <h1>, or <ul><li> wrappers. You can copy plain text, copy rich text, or download the result as a .txt file with one click.

  • Keyboard shortcuts â€“ Press âŒ˜/Ctrl + Enter to regenerate and âŒ˜/Ctrl + C to copy the current output without leaving the text field, matching the tool's frictionless design goal.

  • SEO-friendly landing structure â€“ The page includes a breadcrumb, hero with social proof, feature grid, how-to steps, a comparison table, FAQ accordion with schema markup, and related tool cards, all following the requested section order.

Optimization Tip: The Latin word bank is hardcoded in the FLAVORS object, so you can replace or expand it with your own word lists. The default paragraph count (3) and slider limits are set in the state and UNITS objects if you'd like to adjust them.

  --muted: #8b929c;
  --dim: #5c636e;
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.17);
  --surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028);
  --surface-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
  --track: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
  --accent: #7dd3fc;
  --accent-2: #a78bfa;
  --btn-bg: #fff;
  --btn-fg: #08090a;
  --chip-on-bg: #f2f4f7;
  --chip-on-fg: #08090a;
  --shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg: #fbfbfc;
  --bg-blur: rgba(251, 251, 252, 0.8);
  --text: #0b0c0e;
  --muted: #5b6270;
  --dim: #8a909c;
  --border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  --border-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
  --surface: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.022);
  --surface-2: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  --track: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  --accent: #0284c7;
  --accent-2: #7c3aed;
  --btn-bg: #0b0c0e;
  --btn-fg: #fff;
  --chip-on-bg: #0b0c0e;
  --chip-on-fg: #fff;
  --shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
body::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(680px 460px at 12% -8%, rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.13), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(760px 520px at 88% -4%, rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.12), transparent 70%);
}

::selection { background: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.3); }

/* ---------- component layer ---------- */
.card {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.chip {
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--muted);
  transition: 0.16s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.chip:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface-2); }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--chip-on-bg); color: var(--chip-on-fg); border-color: transparent; font-weight: 600; }

.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
  height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 11px;
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  transition: 0.16s ease; white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.btn-primary {
  background: var(--btn-bg); color: var(--btn-fg);
  border-color: transparent; font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 22px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
.btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }

kbd {
  font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace;
  font-size: 10.5px; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 5px;
  background: rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.22);
}

/* range */
.range { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; background: transparent; height: 20px; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; }
.range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 5px; border-radius: 99px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) var(--pct, 40%), var(--track) var(--pct, 40%));
}
.range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--text); margin-top: -5.5px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.12s;
}
.range::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover { transform: scale(1.14); }
.range::-moz-range-track { height: 5px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--track); }
.range::-moz-range-progress { height: 5px; border-radius: 99px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); }
.range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text); }

/* output prose */
.prose-out { font-family: var(--font-mono), monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.85; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.prose-out.rendered { font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.75; }
.prose-out.rendered h1 { font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.prose-out.rendered p { margin: 0 0 12px; }
.prose-out.rendered ul { margin: 0 0 12px; padding-left: 20px; list-style: disc; }
.prose-out.rendered li { margin-bottom: 8px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}

export type UnitId = "paragraphs" | "sentences" | "words" | "chars";
export type WrapId = "none" | "p" | "h1" | "ul" | "md";

export interface Flavor { id: FlavorId; label: string; blurb: string; words: string[] }
export interface Unit { id: UnitId; label: string; noun: string; min: number; max: number; def: number }
export interface Wrap { id: WrapId; label: string; mono?: boolean }

const w = (s: string) => s.split(/\s+/);

  },

export const UNITS: Unit[] = [
  { id: "paragraphs", label: "Paragraphs", noun: "paragraphs", min: 1, max: 20, def: 3 },
  { id: "sentences",  label: "Sentences",  noun: "sentences",  min: 1, max: 60, def: 5 },
  { id: "words",      label: "Words",      noun: "words",      min: 5, max: 800, def: 60 },
  { id: "chars",      label: "Characters", noun: "characters", min: 20, max: 5000, def: 400 },
];

export const WRAPS: Wrap[] = [
  { id: "none", label: "Plain" },
  { id: "p", label: "<p>", mono: true },
  { id: "h1", label: "<h1>", mono: true },
  { id: "ul", label: "<ul><li>", mono: true },
  { id: "md", label: "Markdown" },
];

const CLASSIC =
  "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.";

/* deterministic-friendly RNG so SSR/CSR never mismatch on the first paint */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = (seed || 1) >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0;
    s ^= s >> 17;
    s ^= s << 5;  s >>>= 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
}

export interface GenOptions {
  flavor: FlavorId; unit: UnitId; amount: number; wrap: WrapId; classic: boolean; seed: number;
}
export interface GenResult {
  paragraphs: string[]; plain: string; wrapped: string; html: string;
  words: number; chars: number; readSeconds: number; ms: number;
}

export function generate(opts: GenOptions): GenResult {
  const t0 = typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : 0;
  const rand = rng(opts.seed);
  const pool = FLAVORS[opts.flavor].words;
  const pick = () => pool[Math.floor(rand() * pool.length)];
  const int = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.floor(rand() * (b - a + 1));

  const sentence = (minW = 7, maxW = 16) => {
    const n = int(minW, maxW);
    const words: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) words.push(pick());
    if (n > 10 && rand() < 0.55) words[Math.floor(n / 2)] += ",";
    if (n > 13 && rand() < 0.3) words[Math.floor(n / 3)] += ",";
    let s = words.join(" ").replace(/,$/, "");
    s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
    return s + (rand() < 0.07 ? "?" : ".");
  };

  const paragraph = () => {
    const n = int(3, 6);
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(sentence());
    return out.join(" ");
  };

  let paragraphs: string[] = [];

  if (opts.unit === "paragraphs") {
    for (let i = 0; i < opts.amount; i++) paragraphs.push(paragraph());
  } else if (opts.unit === "sentences") {
    const s: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < opts.amount; i++) s.push(sentence());
    paragraphs = [s.join(" ")];
  } else if (opts.unit === "words") {
    let words: string[] = [];
    let guard = 0;
    while (words.length < opts.amount && guard++ < 400) {
      words = words.concat(sentence(6, 14).replace(/[.?!]$/, "").split(" "));
    }
    const txt = words.slice(0, opts.amount).join(" ").replace(/,$/, "");
    paragraphs = [txt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + txt.slice(1) + "."];
  } else {
    let text = "";
    let guard = 0;
    while (text.length < opts.amount && guard++ < 400) {
      text += (text ? " " : "") + sentence(6, 14);
    }
    text = text.slice(0, opts.amount);
    const lastSpace = text.lastIndexOf(" ");
    if (lastSpace > opts.amount * 0.75) text = text.slice(0, lastSpace);
    paragraphs = [text.replace(/[,\s]+$/, "")];
  }

  if (opts.classic && opts.flavor === "latin" && (opts.unit === "paragraphs" || opts.unit === "sentences")) {
    paragraphs[0] = `${CLASSIC} ${paragraphs[0]}`;
  }

  const plain = paragraphs.join("\n\n");
  const html = paragraphs.map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join("");
  const words = plain.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;

  const wrapped =
    opts.wrap === "p"  ? paragraphs.map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join("\n") :
    opts.wrap === "h1" ? paragraphs.map((p) => `<h1>${p}</h1>`).join("\n") :
    opts.wrap === "ul" ? `<ul>\n${paragraphs.map((p) => `  <li>${p}</li>`).join("\n")}\n</ul>` :
    opts.wrap === "md" ? paragraphs.map((p) => `- ${p}`).join("\n") :
    plain;

  return {
    paragraphs, plain, wrapped, html,
    words,
    chars: plain.length,
    readSeconds: Math.max(1, Math.round((words / 200) * 60)),
    ms: typeof performance !== "undefined" ? +(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2) : 0,
  };
}

  metadataBase: new URL("https://placehold.tools"),
  title: { default: "Placehold.tools â€” Micro-tools for Designers & Developers", template: "%s" },
  description: "A fast, ad-free collection of micro-tools for designers and developers.",

};

  themeColor: [
    { media: "(prefers-color-scheme: dark)", color: "#08090a" },
    { media: "(prefers-color-scheme: light)", color: "#fbfbfc" },
  ],
};

const themeScript = `
(function(){try{
  var t=localStorage.getItem('theme');
  if(!t) t = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
}catch(e){}})();`;

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" data-theme="dark" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript }} />
      </head>
      <body className={`${sans.variable} ${mono.variable} font-sans antialiased`}>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<"dark" | "light">("dark");

  useEffect(() => {
    setTheme((document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") as "dark" | "light") ?? "dark");
  }, []);

  const toggle = () => {
    const next = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    try { localStorage.setItem("theme", next); } catch {}
    setTheme(next);
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggle}
      aria-label={`Switch to ${theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"} mode`}
      className="grid h-[34px] w-[34px] place-items-center rounded-[9px] border border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--muted)] transition hover:border-[var(--border-strong)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-2)] hover:text-[var(--text)]"
    >
      {theme === "dark" ? <Sun size={16} /> : <Moon size={16} />}
    </button>
  );
}

    () => generate({ flavor, unit, amount, wrap, classic, seed }),

import { FLAVORS, CLASSIC_OPENING, type FlavorId } from "./flavors";

export type Unit = "paragraphs" | "sentences" | "words" | "chars";
export type Wrap = "none" | "p" | "h1" | "ul" | "md";

export const UNITS: { id: Unit; label: string; noun: string; min: number; max: number; def: number }[] = [
  { id: "paragraphs", label: "Paragraphs", noun: "paragraphs", min: 1, max: 20, def: 3 },
  { id: "sentences", label: "Sentences", noun: "sentences", min: 1, max: 60, def: 5 },
  { id: "words", label: "Words", noun: "words", min: 5, max: 800, def: 60 },
  { id: "chars", label: "Characters", noun: "characters", min: 20, max: 5000, def: 400 }
];

export const WRAPS: { id: Wrap; label: string; mono?: boolean }[] = [
  { id: "none", label: "Plain" },
  { id: "p", label: "<p>", mono: true },
  { id: "h1", label: "<h1>", mono: true },
  { id: "ul", label: "<ul><li>", mono: true },
  { id: "md", label: "Markdown" }
];

const rnd = (n: number) => Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
const pick = <T,>(a: T[]) => a[rnd(a.length)];

function sentence(pool: string[], minW = 7, maxW = 16) {
  const n = minW + rnd(maxW - minW + 1);
  const words: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) words.push(pick(pool));
  if (n > 10 && Math.random() < 0.55) words[Math.floor(n / 2)] += ",";
  if (n > 13 && Math.random() < 0.3) words[Math.floor(n / 3)] += ",";
  let s = words.join(" ").replace(/,$/, "");
  s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  return s + (Math.random() < 0.07 ? "?" : ".");
}

function paragraph(pool: string[]) {
  const n = 3 + rnd(4);
  return Array.from({ length: n }, () => sentence(pool)).join(" ");
}

export type GenArgs = {
  flavor: FlavorId;
  unit: Unit;
  amount: number;
  wrap: Wrap;
  classic: boolean;
};

export function generate({ flavor, unit, amount, wrap, classic }: GenArgs) {
  const pool = FLAVORS[flavor].words;
  const paras: string[] = [];

  if (unit === "paragraphs") {
    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) paras.push(paragraph(pool));
  } else if (unit === "sentences") {
    paras.push(Array.from({ length: amount }, () => sentence(pool)).join(" "));
  } else if (unit === "words") {
    let words: string[] = [];
    let guard = 0;
    while (words.length < amount && guard++ < 400) {
      words = words.concat(sentence(pool, 6, 14).replace(/[.?!]$/, "").split(" "));
    }
    paras.push(words.slice(0, amount).join(" ").replace(/,$/, "") + ".");
  } else {
    let text = "";
    let guard = 0;
    while (text.length < amount && guard++ < 400) {
      text += (text ? " " : "") + sentence(pool, 6, 14);
    }
    text = text.slice(0, amount);
    const lastSpace = text.lastIndexOf(" ");
    if (lastSpace > amount * 0.75) text = text.slice(0, lastSpace);
    paras.push(text.replace(/[,\s]+$/, ""));
  }

  if (classic && flavor === "latin" && (unit === "paragraphs" || unit === "sentences")) {
    paras[0] = `${CLASSIC_OPENING} ${paras[0]}`;
  }

  const plain = paras.join("\n\n");
  let wrapped = plain;

  switch (wrap) {
    case "p": wrapped = paras.map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join("\n"); break;
    case "h1": wrapped = paras.map((p) => `<h1>${p}</h1>`).join("\n"); break;
    case "ul": wrapped = `<ul>\n${paras.map((p) => `  <li>${p}</li>`).join("\n")}\n</ul>`; break;
    case "md": wrapped = paras.map((p) => `- ${p}`).join("\n"); break;
  }

  const words = plain.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  return {
    plain,
    wrapped,
    paras,
    words,
    chars: plain.length,
    readSec: Math.max(1, Math.round((words / 200) * 60))
  };
}

:root{
  --font:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","Inter","Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --mono:"SF Mono",ui-monospace,"JetBrains Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --bg:#08090a; --bg-blur:rgba(8,9,10,.72);
  --text:#f2f4f7; --muted:#8b929c; --dim:#5c636e;
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,.09); --border-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.17);
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.028); --surface-2:rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  --track:rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  --accent:#7dd3fc; --accent-2:#a78bfa;
  --btn-bg:#fff; --btn-fg:#08090a;
  --chip-on-bg:#f2f4f7; --chip-on-fg:#08090a;
  --shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85);
}
[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:#fbfbfc; --bg-blur:rgba(251,251,252,.8);
  --text:#0b0c0e; --muted:#5b6270; --dim:#8a909c;
  --border:rgba(0,0,0,.10); --border-strong:rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  --surface:rgba(0,0,0,.022); --surface-2:rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  --track:rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  --accent:#0284c7; --accent-2:#7c3aed;
  --btn-bg:#0b0c0e; --btn-fg:#fff;
  --chip-on-bg:#0b0c0e; --chip-on-fg:#fff;
  --shadow:0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font);font-size:15px;line-height:1.62;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::before{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(680px 460px at 12% -8%, rgba(125,211,252,.13), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(760px 520px at 88% -4%, rgba(167,139,250,.12), transparent 70%);
}
[data-theme="light"] body::before{opacity:.55}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.12;font-weight:600}
p{margin:0}
.container{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}

/* header */
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);background:var(--bg-blur);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.topbar-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:60px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-size:15px}
.logo{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));color:#08090a;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
.nav{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.icon-btn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);transition:.18s}
.icon-btn:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2)}
@media(max-width:820px){.nav{display:none}}

/* breadcrumbs */
.crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:26px 0 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim)}
.crumbs a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.crumbs .sep{opacity:.45}
.crumbs .cur{color:var(--muted)}
.region{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(74,222,128,.15)}

/* hero */
.hero{text-align:center;padding:52px 0 40px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 15px 7px 9px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:26px}
.pill b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.stars{color:#fbbf24;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:11px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,58px);font-weight:600;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2) 70%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hero .sub{max-width:660px;margin:22px auto 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,17.5px);line-height:1.65}
.hero .sub b{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}

/* tool */
.tool{display:grid;grid-template-columns:352px 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:46px;align-items:start;scroll-margin-top:80px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.panel{padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.lbl{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:9px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.chip{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);transition:.16s;white-space:nowrap}
.chip:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--chip-on-bg);color:var(--chip-on-fg);border-color:transparent;font-weight:600}
.chip.mono{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.hint{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim)}
.slider-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;background:transparent;height:20px;width:100%;cursor:pointer;padding:0;margin:0}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent) 0%,var(--accent-2) var(--pct,40%),var(--track) var(--pct,40%))}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text);margin-top:-5.5px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .12s}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.14)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--track)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-progress{height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2))}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text)}
.stepper{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);flex:0 0 auto}
.stepper button{width:30px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1;transition:.15s}
.stepper button:hover{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text)}
.stepper input{width:56px;height:32px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;outline:none;-moz-appearance:textfield}
.stepper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.stepper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.toggle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.switch{width:36px;height:21px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--track);position:relative;transition:.2s;flex:0 0 auto}
.switch span{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text);transition:.2s}
.switch[aria-pressed="true"]{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2))}
.switch[aria-pressed="true"] span{left:17px;background:#fff}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:42px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:11px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:550;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);transition:.16s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{background:var(--surface-2);border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);border-color:transparent;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 6px 22px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn.wide{width:100%}
kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(127,127,127,.18);border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.22);color:inherit;opacity:.85}

/* output */
.output{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:474px;overflow:hidden}
.out-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap}
.stats{display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);font-family:var(--mono)}
.stats b{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tabs button{padding:4px 11px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);transition:.15s}
.tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.tabs button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.out-body{flex:1;margin:0;padding:22px;overflow:auto;max-height:420px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;line-height:1.85;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;color:var(--text);opacity:.94;outline:none}
.out-body.rendered{font-family:var(--font);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;opacity:1}
.out-body.rendered h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 14px;font-weight:600}
.out-body.rendered p{margin:0 0 12px}
.out-body.rendered ul{margin:0 0 12px;padding-left:20px}
.out-body.rendered li{margin-bottom:8px}
.out-foot{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:13px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap}
.out-foot .btn{height:36px;font-size:12.5px;padding:0 14px}
.out-foot .grow{flex:1}
@media(max-width:900px){.tool{grid-template-columns:1fr}.output{min-height:380px}}

/* sections */
section.blk{padding:88px 0 0}
.eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:14px}
.sec-head{max-width:620px;margin-bottom:42px}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,38px)}
.sec-head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;font-size:15.5px}
.grid-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:940px){.grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.feat{padding:24px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);transition:.22s}
.feat:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong);transform:translateY(-3px);background:var(--surface-2)}
.ico{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--accent)}
.feat h3{font-size:15.5px;margin-bottom:8px}
.feat p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:940px){.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.step{padding:24px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface)}
.step .num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.step h3{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px}
.step p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.tbl-wrap{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
th,td{padding:14px 18px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
thead th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--dim);font-weight:600;background:var(--surface-2)}
thead th.ours{color:var(--text)}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
td:first-child{color:var(--muted);font-weight:450}
td.ours{color:var(--text);background:rgba(125,211,252,.045)}

td .no{color:var(--dim)}
.check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:500}
.tbl-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:14px;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:700px){th,td{padding:11px 12px;font-size:12.5px}td:first-child{font-size:12px}}

/* faq */
.faq-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;max-width:840px}
.faq-item{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden;transition:.2s}
.faq-item:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.faq-q{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:19px 22px;text-align:left;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:550;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.faq-q .chev{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.faq-item.open .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.faq-a p{padding:0 22px 20px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.8px;line-height:1.7;max-width:680px}
.faq-a code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;background:var(--surface-2);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border)}

/* related */
.rel-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
@media(max-width:940px){.rel-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.rel-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:17px 18px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);transition:.2s}
.rel:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2)}
.rel .ri{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto}
.rel h4{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:550;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.rel p{margin:1px 0 0;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim)}

footer{margin-top:88px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:34px 0 44px}
.foot-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim)}
.foot-links{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot-links a:hover{color:var(--text)}

/* toast */
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:34px;transform:translate(-50%,26px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:200;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);font-size:13px;font-weight:550;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),opacity .22s;max-width:92vw}
.toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0);opacity:1}
.toast .tk{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(74,222,128,.95);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#062;flex:0 0 auto}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--track);border-radius:99px;border:3px solid transparent;background-clip:content-box}
::selection{background:rgba(125,211,252,.3)}
</style>

  <section class="blk" id="faq">

    <div class="faq-list" id="faqList">
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">What is a lorem ipsum generator?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>A lorem ipsum generator produces dummy placeholder text so designers and developers can fill layouts, wireframes, mockups and CMS templates before real copy exists. The classic Latin passage dates back to Cicero's <em>De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum</em> (45 BC) and has been the design industry's standard filler since the 1500s.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Can I generate an exact number of characters or bytes?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>Yes. Switch the <strong>Generate by</strong> control to <em>Characters</em> and the generator will produce text trimmed to the nearest word boundary under your limit â€” perfect for meta descriptions, tweet-length previews, or database column constraints. The live character counter in the output header updates as you drag the slider.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">What are the Startup SaaS and Tech Geek flavors?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>They are themed word banks that replace Latin with vocabulary real teams use. <strong>Startup SaaS</strong> generates terms like <code>north-star</code>, <code>runway</code> and <code>product-market</code>; <strong>Tech Geek</strong> uses <code>middleware</code>, <code>idempotent</code> and <code>race-condition</code>. They make landing-page demos and internal prototypes feel far more convincing than Latin.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Can I copy the text with HTML tags already applied?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>Absolutely. Choose a wrapper such as <code>&lt;p&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;</code> or Markdown, then hit <strong>Copy plain</strong> to get the raw markup. If you want formatted text for Figma, Notion or Google Docs, use <strong>Copy rich text</strong> â€” it places properly styled HTML on your clipboard via the async Clipboard API.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <button class="faq-q">Is this tool free, and is my text stored anywhere?<svg class="chev" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>It is completely free with no account, no usage cap and no ads. All generation happens 100% client-side in your browser â€” nothing you type or generate is ever transmitted to a server, logged or stored.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

/* ============ word banks ============ */
function w(s){ return s.split(/\s+/); }
var FLAVORS = {
  latin: { label:"Latin", words:w("lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipiscing elit sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua enim ad minim veniam quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi aliquip ex ea commodo consequat duis aute irure in reprehenderit voluptate velit esse cillum eu fugiat nulla pariatur excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident sunt culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum vestibulum curabitur pellentesque fermentum aliquam maecenas mauris nunc congue nisi viverra accumsan in nisl tincidunt eget nullam non nisi est sit amet facilisis magna etiam tempor orci eu lobortis elementum nibh tellus molestie") },
  saas: { label:"Startup SaaS", words:w("leverage synergy paradigm disrupt scalable growth north-star runway pivot iterate ship launch roadmap onboarding retention churn funnel conversion cohort metrics dashboard insights velocity bandwidth stakeholder alignment ecosystem flywheel moat playbook touchpoint delight friction seamless robust holistic granular actionable best-in-class mission-critical growth-hack product-market buy-in circle-back deep-dive double-click ideate operationalize synergize unlock empower streamline accelerate optimize monetize validate benchmark segment activate") },
  tech: { label:"Tech Geek", words:w("async middleware runtime regex docker kubernetes git rebase merge commit deploy pipeline endpoint payload cache latency thread mutex semaphore heap stack pointer null undefined closure promise callback hook reducer state props bundle transpile lint refactor monorepo microservice serverless container orchestration telemetry schema migration shard replica idempotent polymorphic recursive binary hex buffer socket daemon kernel shell sudo") },
  cyber: { label:"Cyberpunk", words:w("neon chrome rain sprawl consortium black-ice dermal grid arcology synth implant netrunner datajack corp zaibatsu hacker deck neural static hologram decay smog platinum circuit overclock glitch cyberware biotech firmware uplink downlink firewall encryption access-code night-city rain-slicked vapor haze chrome-plated augmented rogue singularity") },
  food: { label:"Gourmet Food", words:w("saffron truffle seared confit emulsion miso yuzu sourdough caramelized infused braised reduction gastrique umami artisan heirloom foraged fermented smoked charred drizzle zest blanched julienne bechamel roux sous-vide marbled tartare crudo consomme veloute beurre fondant ganache praline citrus herbaceous peppery silken") }
};

var UNITS = [
  { id:"paragraphs", label:"Paragraphs", noun:"paragraphs", min:1, max:20, def:3 },
  { id:"sentences",  label:"Sentences",  noun:"sentences",  min:1, max:60, def:5 },
  { id:"words",      label:"Words",      noun:"words",      min:5, max:800, def:60 },
  { id:"chars",      label:"Characters", noun:"characters", min:20, max:5000, def:400 }
];

var WRAPS = [
  { id:"none", label:"Plain" },
  { id:"p",    label:"<p>", mono:true },
  { id:"h1",   label:"<h1>", mono:true },
  { id:"ul",   label:"<ul><li>", mono:true },
  { id:"md",   label:"Markdown" }
];

var CLASSIC = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.";

/* ============ state ============ */
var state = {
  flavor:"latin",
  unit:"paragraphs",
  amount:3,
  wrap:"none",
  classic:true,
  view:"code"
};

/* ============ helpers ============ */
var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
function rnd(n){ return Math.floor(Math.random()*n); }
function pick(a){ return a[rnd(a.length)]; }

function makeSentence(pool, minW, maxW){
  minW = minW || 7; maxW = maxW || 16;
  var n = minW + rnd(maxW - minW + 1);
  var words = [];
  for (var i=0;i<n;i++) words.push(pick(pool));
  if (n > 10 && Math.random() < 0.55) words[Math.floor(n/2)] += ",";
  if (n > 13 && Math.random() < 0.3)  words[Math.floor(n/3)] += ",";
  var s = words.join(" ").replace(/,$/, "");
  s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  s += (Math.random() < 0.07 ? "?" : ".");
  return s;
}

function makeParagraph(pool){
  var n = 3 + rnd(4);
  var out = [];
  for (var i=0;i<n;i++) out.push(makeSentence(pool));
  return out.join(" ");
}

/* ============ generation ============ */
function generateParagraphs(){
  var pool = FLAVORS[state.flavor].words;
  var paras = [];
  var i, guard;

  if (state.unit === "paragraphs"){
    for (i=0;i<state.amount;i++) paras.push(makeParagraph(pool));
  }
  else if (state.unit === "sentences"){
    var s = [];
    for (i=0;i<state.amount;i++) s.push(makeSentence(pool));
    paras.push(s.join(" "));
  }
  else if (state.unit === "words"){
    var words = [];
    guard = 0;
    while (words.length < state.amount && guard++ < 400){
      var sent = makeSentence(pool, 6, 14).replace(/[.?!]$/, "");
      words = words.concat(sent.split(" "));
    }
    words = words.slice(0, state.amount);
    var txt = words.join(" ").replace(/,$/, "");
    paras.push(txt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + txt.slice(1) + ".");
  }
  else {
    var text = "";
    guard = 0;
    while (text.length < state.amount && guard++ < 400){
      text += (text ? " " : "") + makeSentence(pool, 6, 14);
    }
    text = text.slice(0, state.amount);
    var lastSpace = text.lastIndexOf(" ");
    if (lastSpace > state.amount * 0.75) text = text.slice(0, lastSpace);
    paras.push(text.replace(/[,\s]+$/, ""));
  }

  if (state.classic && state.flavor === "latin" &&
      (state.unit === "paragraphs" || state.unit === "sentences")){
    paras[0] = CLASSIC + " " + paras[0];
  }
  return paras;
}

function applyWrap(paras){
  switch(state.wrap){
    case "p":  return paras.map(function(p){ return "<p>" + p + "</p>"; }).join("\n");
    case "h1": return paras.map(function(p){ return "<h1>" + p + "</h1>"; }).join("\n");
    case "ul": return "<ul>\n" + paras.map(function(p){ return "  <li>" + p + "</li>"; }).join("\n") + "\n</ul>";
    case "md": return paras.map(function(p){ return "- " + p; }).join("\n");
    default:   return paras.join("\n\n");
  }
}

/* ============ render ============ */
var outEl = $("out");

function render(){
  var t0 = performance.now();
  var paras = generateParagraphs();
  var wrapped = applyWrap(paras);
  var plain = paras.join("\n\n");

  var renderedOK = (state.wrap === "p" || state.wrap === "h1" || state.wrap === "ul");
  if (state.view === "rendered" && renderedOK){
    outEl.classList.add("rendered");
    outEl.innerHTML = wrapped;
  } else {
    outEl.classList.remove("rendered");
    outEl.textContent = wrapped;
  }

  var words = plain.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  var chars = plain.length;
  var secs = Math.max(1, Math.round((words / 200) * 60));
  $("statWords").textContent = words.toLocaleString();
  $("statChars").textContent = chars.toLocaleString();
  $("statRead").textContent  = secs < 60 ? secs + "s" : Math.round(secs/60) + "m";

  return { plain: plain, wrapped: wrapped, html: paras.map(function(p){ return "<p>"+p+"</p>"; }).join(""),
           ms: (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2) };
}

/* ============ chips ============ */
function buildChips(containerId, items, current, onPick){
  var el = $(containerId);
  el.innerHTML = "";
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.className = "chip" + (it.mono ? " mono" : "");
    b.textContent = it.label;
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(it.id === current));
    b.dataset.id = it.id;
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){ onPick(it.id); });
    el.appendChild(b);
  });
}
function syncChips(containerId, id){
  Array.prototype.forEach.call($(containerId).children, function(b){
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.id === id));
  });
}

function currentUnit(){
  for (var i=0;i<UNITS.length;i++) if (UNITS[i].id === state.unit) return UNITS[i];
  return UNITS[0];
}

function setAmount(v){
  var u = currentUnit();
  v = Math.max(u.min, Math.min(u.max, Math.round(v) || u.min));
  state.amount = v;
  $("amount").value = v;
  $("amountNum").value = v;
  var pct = ((v - u.min) / (u.max - u.min)) * 100;
  $("amount").style.setProperty("--pct", pct + "%");
  $("amtHint").textContent = v === 1 ? u.noun.replace(/s$/, "") : u.noun;
}

function setUnit(id){
  state.unit = id;
  syncChips("units", id);
  var u = currentUnit();
  $("amount").min = u.min;
  $("amount").max = u.max;
  setAmount(u.def);
  // auto-reset rendered view if wrapper no longer supports it
  var renderedTab = document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="rendered"]');
  var canRender = (state.wrap === "p" || state.wrap === "h1" || state.wrap === "ul");
  renderedTab.disabled = !canRender;
  if (!canRender && state.view === "rendered"){
    state.view = "code";
    document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="code"]').setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");
    renderedTab.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
  }
  render();
}

/* ============ toast ============ */
var toastTimer = null;
function toast(msg){
  $("toastMsg").textContent = msg;
  var t = $("toast");
  t.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove("show"); }, 1900);
}

/* ============ clipboard ============ */
function legacyCopy(text){
  var ta = document.createElement("textarea");
  ta.value = text;
  ta.style.position = "fixed";
  ta.style.opacity = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.select();
  try { document.execCommand("copy"); } catch(e){}
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
}

async function copyPlain(){
  var r = render();
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text Â· " + r.plain.length.toLocaleString() + " chars");
  } catch(e){
    legacyCopy(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text");
  }
}

async function copyRich(){
  var r = render();
  try {
    if (window.ClipboardItem){
      var item = new ClipboardItem({
        "text/html":  new Blob([r.html],  { type:"text/html" }),
        "text/plain": new Blob([r.plain], { type:"text/plain" })
      });
      await navigator.clipboard.write([item]);
      toast("Copied rich text Â· paste into Figma or Docs");
    } else {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(r.plain);
      toast("Copied as plain text");
    }
  } catch(e){
    legacyCopy(r.plain);
    toast("Copied plain text (rich copy unavailable)");
  }
}

/* ============ init ============ */
function init(){
  // flavor chips
  var flavorItems = Object.keys(FLAVORS).map(function(k){ return { id:k, label:FLAVORS[k].label }; });
  buildChips("flavors", flavorItems, state.flavor, function(id){
    state.flavor = id;
    syncChips("flavors", id);
    $("classicRow").style.display = (id === "latin") ? "flex" : "none";
    render();
  });

  // unit chips
  buildChips("units", UNITS, state.unit, setUnit);

  // wrap chips
  buildChips("wraps", WRAPS, state.wrap, function(id){
    state.wrap = id;
    syncChips("wraps", id);
    var canRender = (id === "p" || id === "h1" || id === "ul");
    var rTab = document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="rendered"]');
    rTab.disabled = !canRender;
    if (!canRender && state.view === "rendered"){
      state.view = "code";
      document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-view="code"]').setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");
      rTab.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
    }
    render();
  });

  // amount
  $("amount").addEventListener("input", function(e){ setAmount(+e.target.value); render(); });
  $("amountNum").addEventListener("input", function(e){ setAmount(+e.target.value); render(); });
  $("minus").addEventListener("click", function(){ setAmount(state.amount - 1); render(); });
  $("plus").addEventListener("click",  function(){ setAmount(state.amount + 1); render(); });

  // classic switch
  $("classicSwitch").addEventListener("click", function(){
    state.classic = !state.classic;
    this.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(state.classic));
    render();
  });

  // regenerate
  $("regen").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var r = render();
    toast("Regenerated in " + r.ms + " ms");
  });

  // copy / download
  $("copyPlain").addEventListener("click", copyPlain);
  $("copyRich").addEventListener("click", copyRich);
  $("dl").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var r = render();
    var blob = new Blob([r.wrapped], { type:"text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = "placeholder-" + state.flavor + "-" + Date.now() + ".txt";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1500);
    toast("Downloaded .txt");
  });

  // view tabs
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button"), function(b){
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){
      if (b.disabled) return;
      state.view = b.dataset.view;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button"), function(x){
        x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(x.dataset.view === state.view));
      });
      render();
    });
  });

  // FAQ accordion
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item"), function(item){
    var q = item.querySelector(".faq-q");
    var a = item.querySelector(".faq-a");
    q.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item"), function(other){
        other.classList.remove("open");
        other.querySelector(".faq-a").style.maxHeight = "0px";
      });
      if (!isOpen){
        item.classList.add("open");
        a.style.maxHeight = a.scrollHeight + "px";
      }
    });
  });

  // theme
  $("themeBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var root = document.documentElement;
    var next = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    toast(next === "dark" ? "Dark mode" : "Light mode");
  });

  // keyboard shortcuts
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    var mod = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (!mod) return;
    if (e.key === "Enter"){
      e.preventDefault();
      var r = render();
      toast("Regenerated in " + r.ms + " ms");
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "c" || e.key === "C"){
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      if (sel && sel.toString().length > 0) return;
      var t = e.target;
      if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      copyPlain();
    }
  });

  // boot
  $("classicRow").style.display = "flex";
  setUnit("paragraphs");
  render();
}

init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
